title: At the Restaurant
text:
A menu is a list of food and drinks in a restaurant. The menu has prices next to each dish. Anna opens the menu and reads it slowly. She likes the soup.

Tom wants a sandwich and a glass of juice. The waiter writes the order on paper. Tom says thank you. The food comes quickly.

options: A list of food and drinks in a restaurant

questions.text: What does Tom want to order?
options: A sandwich and a glass of juice

questions.text: Why does Anna read the menu slowly?
options: She wants to choose a meal

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about the service?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that a restaurant offers
the amount of money that you pay for something
a person who brings food and drinks to people in a restaurant

paragraph_translations: Menu to lista jedzenia i napojów w restauracji. W menu obok każdego dania są ceny. Anna otwiera menu i czyta je powoli. Lubi zupę.
Tomek chce kanapkę i szklankę soku. Kelner zapisuje zamówienie na papierze. Tomek mówi dziękuję. Jedzenie przychodzi szybko.
